concerns.text: FR-012 requires a GitHub Actions workflow at `.github/workflows/ci.yml` that enforces RAM and time limits. No task in tasks.md implements this workflow (task T004b is pending), leaving the functional requirement uncovered.

FR-019 mandates validation of experiment artifacts against both `contracts/experiment_results.schema.yaml` and `contracts/experiment.schema.yaml` during CI. Tasks only include contract tests for `state.yaml` and other artifacts, but no task explicitly validates the full set of experiment artifacts, so the requirement is not covered.

FR-020 states that the subspace mask must be derived from an independent set of mask‑derivation seeds distinct from evaluation seeds. While mask‑derivation code (T052) exists, there is no dedicated task that verifies or documents the separation of seed sets, leaving the requirement unaddressed.
